title: Another machine can win the next day's cron lock while a run still goes, and the same machine re-acquires a day it already finished after a restart
evidence: app/lib/supabase-cron-lock.server.ts: cron_lock.run_state and finished_at (applied 2026-11-11, Brad's yes); the acquire refuses a finished or legacy-NULL day to every machine, gives a failed or dead running row back to its own machine, frees a running row past the stuck limit, and blocks the next day while a run is live and fresh; one update with no .select(), then a verify that compares locked_at as an instant; endCronLock writes finished or failed keyed by owner and date. One stuck-limit table (cron-day.ts STUCK_AFTER_HOURS) for the tick and the lock. MACHINE_ID is null with no FLY_MACHINE_ID. Reminder day-stamp (attempting_on, reminder-v2-day-stamp.server.ts) stops repeat sends on a same-day re-run. Tests failing first: cron-lock-run-state.test.ts, cron-lock-restart.test.ts, cron-day.test.ts, reminder-v2-day-stamp.test.ts. US-28 AC9, US-23 AC15
